proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Lobbying Disclosure
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing Abbott's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association memberships, and oversight of lobbying payments.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Non-GAAP Financial Performance Metrics Disclosure
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to require CD&A explanation and GAAP reconciliation whenever GAAP metrics are adjusted for senior executive incentive compensation.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Shareholder Voting on By-law Amendments
proposals.topic_summary: Requests that board-approved bylaw amendments be subject to a non-binding shareholder vote unless already subject to a binding vote.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Simple Majority Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Requests replacing two-thirds supermajority vote provisions under the Illinois Business Corporation Act with a majority of outstanding shares.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal.
